rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for transferring, providing, handing over, causing a feeling, or administering something.

example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 ni1 bun2 syu1 nei5

rows.note: Use this for transmitting an illness or infection to someone, usually in 傳染畀 A.

example.english: If you are ill, do not give me your illness.
example.traditional: 你病咗就唔好傳染畀我。
example.jyutping: nei5 beng6 zo2 zau6 m4 hou2 cyun4 jim5 bei2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when the thing is being given specifically as a present or gift, rather than simply transferred.

example.jyutping: ngo5 sung3 nei5 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6

rows.note: Use this when give means to promise or commit yourself to doing something for someone.

example.english: When you give me your word, you have to keep it.
example.traditional: 你應承我，就一定要做到。
example.jyutping: nei5 jing1 sing4 ngo5 zau6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 dou3
